title: DXY Regime Update
confirmation: U.S. yields remain firm while inflation or growth releases beat the cooling narrative.
invalidation: Treasury yields decline alongside softer labor and inflation data.
hook: Here is what is driving the dollar today.
voiceoverScript: Here is what is driving the dollar today. Macro FX Monitor shows a bullish USD bias, with the DXY score at plus 2.2 out of 10. The strongest drivers are CPI, Treasury yields, and Fed expectations. Confirmation would come from firm U.S. yields and resilient macro data. But this bias breaks if inflation and labor data soften alongside yields. Educational research only, not investment advice.
